purpose: Prevent Driver-review stalls without reintroducing latest-review-wins. Follow-up consumes the single operational review authority produced by the exact-set review reducer. One immutable review is authority directly; two or more immutable reviews first require exact-set intake, two reference passes and review synthesis. Only that synthesis may drive follow-up. Any operational authority created after the exact d1514b1 cutover cannot terminalize ordinary or parallel runtime authority until a valid follow-up taskset is immutably published, or the current parent Objective is already canonically CLOSED. Existing concurrent control assets may satisfy a gate only by explicit pinned evidence so the rule never creates duplicate work merely to satisfy itself.
external_prior_art_minimum_scope: search independent external literature/repository sources using task-specific queries
record search date, search surfaces, queries and candidate matches
separate exact duplicate, partial antecedent, adjacent method and no material match
do not infer novelty merely from no match
return evidence refs sufficient for a Driver to audit the search
lean_task_minimum_scope: pin the exact theorem statement and source result
preserve theorem strength unless Driver explicitly issues a new weaker task
forbid sorry/admit/custom axiom when the task requires full formal closure
run the taskbook-specified warning-fatal build/check gate
freeze theorem-source blob and build provenance

automatic_materialization.second_or_later_review_command: python tools/research_result_records.py review ... WITHOUT --followup-spec; exact-set review authority reopens
automatic_materialization.first_review_transaction: preflight gate/task specifications; create the first immutable review; automatically publish missing follow-up taskbook(s) and immutable publication record(s); then create one immutable authority follow-up packet
automatic_materialization.multiple_review_transaction: create the additional immutable source review; do not publish source-specific follow-up; resolve exact-set review authority through two reference passes and synthesis; then materialize follow-up for the synthesis authority
automatic_materialization.failure_semantics: fail closed; operational review authority remains nonterminal until a valid packet exists. Any already-created partial publication remains immutable evidence and is never silently rolled back.
automatic_materialization.parent_objective_rule: all newly published follow-up task publications keep the reviewed source task parent_objective_id
automatic_materialization.revision_rule: a revision may publish a new generation of the same task only through explicit supersedes_publication_id and a new immutable taskbook path

anti_spam_and_successor_compatibility.interpretation: the operational review checkpoint must choose and materialize the next control action, but each CONTINUATION task must independently satisfy the existing successor_gate with a genuine information gap, discriminating outcomes, kill condition and alternative-route analysis; a concurrent already-materialized route should be pinned with SATISFIED_BY_EXISTING_CONTROL_ASSET instead of duplicated
anti_spam_and_successor_compatibility.parent_closed_behavior: do not manufacture meaningless successors; use PARENT_OBJECTIVE_CLOSURE after canonical Objective closure

historical_compatibility.cutover_basis: source review_id exact membership for immutable reviews present at cutover; no review synthesis authority existed at cutover
historical_compatibility.future_hardening: source-backed active Driver authorization remains a separate independent hardening layer; it must not weaken this frozen-ID cutover
